blurb: Deep integer expression chains: precedence, ternary, comma-like side effects, shifts, mod, and an avalanche-style accumulator loop
Bit-packing/unpacking of an RGBA pixel plus 3-bit flags into a u32, with a round-trip verification loop using struct fields, shifts and masks
Hand-rolled popcount two ways (Kernighan bit-clear loop + SWAR) and a parity computed via a 16-entry LUT packed in a constant, cross-checked over LCG-varied inputs
Q16.16 fixed-point arithmetic: mul/div via 64-bit intermediates and a Newton-iteration fixed-point sqrt, accumulating pi*r^2 with no float I/O
CRC-32 (bit-at-a-time, branchless mask trick) over a string plus square-and-multiply modular exponentiation used for a Fermat little-theorem primality check
A 64-bit MMIX-style LCG RNG feeding a top-bits histogram plus integer running sum/sum-of-squares, with float mean/variance/sqrt at the end (printed as ints)
Five classic recursive functions (factorial, gcd, fibonacci, ackermann, towers-of-hanoi move count) — exercises self/mutual/tree recursion and tail-call shapes.
Triple-nested matrix multiply plus a doubly-nested Sieve of Eratosthenes — exercises deep loop nesting and induction-variable analysis.
A tiny stack-VM bytecode interpreter dispatched by a switch over opcodes — exercises jump-table recovery and a while+switch loop.
A lexer-style finite state machine built entirely from labels and goto — exercises irreducible/back-edge control flow and label recovery.
Triangle classifier with stacked guard clauses and early returns, fed through a switch namer — exercises short-circuit conditions and multi-exit functions.
Two post-test do/while loops: a Collatz step-counter and an integer digit-reversal — exercises bottom-tested loop reconstruction.
Bubble, insertion, and selection sort on three separate int arrays — three classic nested-loop sort shapes with in-place swaps in one program
Binary search (while-loop with lo/hi/mid branching) plus in-place two-pointer reverse on a std::vector — exercises divide-and-conquer control flow and range-for iteration
From-scratch strlen/strcmp/strcpy reimplemented with raw pointer arithmetic — pointer-walking loops the decompiler must recover as the standard string idioms
Classic 3x3 matrix multiply with the triple-nested i/j/k loop and accumulator — 2D array indexing and the canonical matmul shape
Run-length encoder: scans a C string, counts consecutive runs, and emits char+count digit pairs into an output buffer — nested while-loops over a flat char array
Counting/histogram pass: tallies letter frequencies into a 26-bucket array, finds total+peak, then renders bars — array-as-accumulator with a char-to-index map
C structs with functions taking T*: Point distance (sqrt) and Rectangle area, plus an in-place mutator via pointer — exercises arrow-operator member access and nested-struct field access.

C++ class with private fields (string owner, long balance) and public deposit/withdraw methods returning bool, with input validation — exercises encapsulation, const accessors, and a guarded branch on member state.
A small Counter class with a configurable step, tick/untick/reset methods, and a static instance tally — exercises instance method calls, a static member variable, and a loop driving member mutation.

A Vec2 value class with overloaded operator+ and operator== plus a scaled() method returning a new instance — exercises operator overloading, by-value returns of class objects, and a boolean compound condition on members.

A class hierarchy via composition: Car owns an Engine and Wheels as member objects and delegates to their methods — exercises nested member-object construction, delegated method calls, and access to sub-object state.

An enum + struct state machine: a traffic light whose phase advances through RED/GREEN/YELLOW with per-state durations and a cycle counter — exercises enum-driven switch dispatch, struct-pointer mutation, and modular state transition.
Singly linked list with heap nodes: push-front, length, sum via pointer chasing — exercises malloc/free, struct self-reference, and pointer-walk loops the decompiler must rebuild as a list traversal.
Fixed-capacity array-backed stack (no heap): push/pop with a top index and bounds checks — exercises struct field access, static member constant, and reference-parameter mutation.

Binary search tree: recursive insert + recursive inorder traversal counting nodes and summing keys — exercises recursion, two-child pointer dispatch, and reference accumulators the decompiler must structure.
Hash bucket histogram: multiplicative-mix hash of uint32 keys into fixed buckets, then count loads and find the busiest — exercises bit-mix arithmetic, modulo, and array-indexed accumulation.
Pointer-walk over an array with a moving pointer for the sum, plus in-place reverse using a swap-by-pointer helper — exercises pointer arithmetic, two-pointer convergence, and deref swaps.

Function-pointer dispatch table: an opcode/lhs/rhs bytecode program selects an int binary op from a name+fnptr table and accumulates results — exercises function pointers, indirect calls, and table-driven control flow.
Recursive in-place quicksort (Lomuto partition) over a fixed int array; exercises nested recursion, pointer swaps, and a partition loop
Levenshtein edit distance via rolling 1-D DP rows; exercises std::vector, std::min nesting, and row-swap DP control flow
Sieve of Eratosthenes up to 100; exercises a byte bitmap, nested loops with p*p start, and a long-cast overflow guard
Tokenizer + word-frequency table over a fixed paragraph, sorted by count via a lambda comparator; exercises char-class branching, struct vector, and std::sort
Integer-to-string base conversion (binary/octal/hex) done by hand with a digit reversal buffer; exercises modulo loops, a lookup table, and uint32_t casts
Stack-based RPN/postfix evaluator over whitespace tokens with an error path; exercises a vector-as-stack, istringstream tokenizing, and operator dispatch
Tiny CLI argument parser (flags + value-options + positional); exercises argv loops, strcmp chains, atoi, branchy flag dispatch and a counted output loop.
Temperature + distance unit converter; exercises std::string dispatch, NaN sentinels, floating-point arithmetic helpers and an argv-vs-demo-table branch.
Grade/stats calculator over a fixed vector (mean/min/max/stddev + letter-grade histogram); exercises range-for reductions, sqrt, and an array-indexed bucket count.
Caesar + XOR cipher over a fixed string with round-trip self-check; exercises modular char arithmetic, uint8 XOR over a buffer, hex dump loop and strcmp verification.
Finite-state machine: a vending machine driven by a fixed event tape; exercises enum-class state transitions, a struct-of-events vector, and state-gated dispense/reject branching.
Mini stack-machine interpreter running a fixed bytecode program; exercises an opcode switch dispatch loop, an instruction pointer, a value stack, and a computed return code.
Nested ternaries (4-deep) + tagged union with enum class type tag — exercises chained cmov/branch lowering and union member punning by tag.
Packed 32-bit bitfield struct (5/6/5/4/12) with masking, xor and overflow assign — exercises shift/and/or bitfield extract-insert lowering and width truncation.
Varargs-free printf-style formatter: char-by-char format state machine + manual itoa over a parallel int array into a fixed buffer — exercises loop/branch control flow and pointer-offset writes.
Enum-driven switch returning string literals, with an intentional DIV/MOD fallthrough group — exercises jump-table vs if-chain lowering and shared case blocks.
Heavy const-folding: constexpr fact/fib/gcd + a folded loop blob, consumed by static_asserts — the recursive/iterative bodies vanish into baked literals at the call sites.
Pointer arithmetic with reinterpret casts (byte buffer read as uint32 via w+i) plus a true 2D array parameter int g[ROWS][COLS] — exercises scaled-index addressing and 2D row-stride decay.
